misses.answer: No. Amazon Bedrock does not add a routing fee for cross-Region inference. You pay the price based on the Region from which you call the inference profile. (Note that the docs say pricing is based on the calling Region, not the Region where the request is processed.)

misses.answer: No. Destination Regions do not need to be manually enabled (opted in) on your account for Bedrock cross-Region inference to work. The documentation says cross-Region inference can route requests to Regions that are not manually enabled in your account. Note that this is exactly opt-in only: if you use a Geographic profile, your service control policies (SCPs) must allow all destination Regions in the profile, and a Global profile requires allowing "aws:RequestedRegion": "unspecified".

misses.answer: Yes. On-demand Serverless Inference scales the endpoint down to zero when there are no requests, which minimizes cost. The trade-off is cold starts when traffic resumes after an idle period. (Optional Provisioned Concurrency keeps capacity warm, so it is not scaled to zero in the same way.)
